behoerden.mit.name: MİT (intelligence service)
behoerden.mit.text: Foreign and domestic intelligence, counter-intelligence, cyber and protection of the president. More staff means more operations at once, better technology means better odds and fewer exposures, more reach means deeper networks abroad.
behoerden.mit.personal.wirkung: More capacity and faster recruitment: the service can do more at once.
behoerden.mit.technik.wirkung: Better odds, fewer exposures, foreign operations are found sooner.
behoerden.mit.reichweite.wirkung: Deeper networks abroad and assessments that last longer; from level 4, support for groups.
behoerden.polizei.name: Police and Gendarmerie
behoerden.polizei.text: Security in cities (police) and the countryside (gendarmerie). More presence lowers crime; more powers without oversight cost trust.
behoerden.polizei.personal.wirkung: More officers on the street: crime falls noticeably.
behoerden.polizei.technik.wirkung: Situation centres and forensics: crime and corruption fall.
behoerden.polizei.reichweite.wirkung: Gendarmerie across the country: less rural crime, lower terror threat.
behoerden.polizei.instrument.name: Crackdown on organised crime
behoerden.polizei.instrument.text: A year of concentrated investigations into gangs and money laundering: crime and corruption fall at once, civil-rights groups warn of abuses.
behoerden.justiz.name: Justice and Courts
behoerden.justiz.text: Courts, prosecutors, prisons. The case backlog is the bottleneck: more judges and better procedures shorten it, but only after years.
behoerden.justiz.personal.wirkung: More judges and prosecutors: faster cases, emptier prisons.
behoerden.justiz.technik.wirkung: Electronic files and workflows: faster cases, more legal certainty.
behoerden.justiz.reichweite.wirkung: Training and specialised chambers: more reliable rulings, growing trust.
behoerden.justiz.instrument.name: Special chambers against the backlog
behoerden.justiz.instrument.text: Temporary chambers clear old cases: the backlog falls fast, critics see rushed trials and pressure on independence.
behoerden.steuer.name: Tax Administration
behoerden.steuer.text: Tax offices and audit services. Every lira not evaded is one nobody has to pay extra; auditors make few friends among traders and firms.
behoerden.steuer.personal.wirkung: More auditors: higher revenue, smaller shadow economy.
behoerden.steuer.technik.wirkung: E-invoicing and data matching: more revenue, better tax morale.
behoerden.steuer.reichweite.wirkung: Audits across the country: less undeclared work, but pressure on small firms.
behoerden.steuer.instrument.name: Data matching against tax evasion
behoerden.steuer.instrument.text: Bank, land-registry and invoice data are matched: more revenue at once, business owners complain of blanket suspicion.
behoerden.afad.name: AFAD (disaster management)
behoerden.afad.text: Preparedness and relief for earthquakes, floods and fires. What is missing here shows only in a disaster; what is invested here almost never shows.
behoerden.afad.personal.wirkung: More rescue staff: help arrives faster.
behoerden.afad.technik.wirkung: Early warning, equipment and stockpiles: better protection and preparedness.
behoerden.afad.reichweite.wirkung: Bases in every province: preparedness far from the big cities too.
behoerden.afad.instrument.name: Nationwide earthquake drill
behoerden.afad.instrument.text: Schools, hospitals and authorities rehearse the emergency: protection and preparedness rise, and citizens see the state is ready.
behoerden.gesundheit.name: Health Service
behoerden.gesundheit.text: Hospitals, family doctors, public-health offices. Doctors do not grow back in a year, and poor pay loses them abroad.
behoerden.gesundheit.personal.wirkung: More doctors and nurses: shorter waiting times.
behoerden.gesundheit.technik.wirkung: Equipment and digitisation: better care, more reliable medicines.
behoerden.gesundheit.reichweite.wirkung: Clinics and doctors across the country: care in rural areas too.
behoerden.gesundheit.instrument.name: Mobile medical teams for the east
behoerden.gesundheit.instrument.text: Medical teams tour underserved provinces for a year: waiting times fall, poor households notice at once.
behoerden.bildung.name: Education Administration
behoerden.bildung.text: Schools, teachers, curricula. The return comes late: invest today, get the skilled workers in ten years.
behoerden.bildung.personal.wirkung: More teachers, smaller classes: better education, fewer dropouts.
behoerden.bildung.technik.wirkung: Equipment and curricula: better education and more skilled workers.
behoerden.bildung.reichweite.wirkung: Schools and full-day care across the country: fewer dropouts, more girls stay in school.
behoerden.bildung.instrument.name: Teacher programme for deprived areas
behoerden.bildung.instrument.text: Extra teachers for schools with many dropouts: dropouts fall, young people see a chance.
behoerden.diplomatie.name: Diplomatic Service
behoerden.diplomatie.text: Embassies, consulates, trade offices. Standing and markets abroad also depend on who speaks on the ground.
behoerden.diplomatie.personal.wirkung: More diplomats: more of a hearing in the world.
behoerden.diplomatie.technik.wirkung: Analysis and communication: better standing, slightly more exports.
behoerden.diplomatie.reichweite.wirkung: More missions: standing, Middle East relations and exports grow.
behoerden.diplomatie.instrument.name: Mediation offensive
behoerden.diplomatie.instrument.text: Ankara offers itself as mediator in a conflict: standing and relations grow as long as nobody demands success.
behoerden.statistik.name: Statistics Office (TÜİK)
behoerden.statistik.text: Inflation, unemployment, growth: credible figures make credit cheaper. Independent figures also show what the government would rather not see.
behoerden.statistik.personal.wirkung: More statisticians: slightly more market confidence.
behoerden.statistik.technik.wirkung: Better surveys: more market confidence, better planning.
behoerden.statistik.reichweite.wirkung: Independent leadership and open methods: markets trust much more, the government must live with uncomfortable figures.
behoerden.statistik.instrument.name: Independent review of inflation figures
behoerden.statistik.instrument.text: Outside experts review the methods: markets and investors gain confidence, trust in the government falls because the figures look worse.
behoerden.grenzschutz.name: Border Guard and Coast Guard
behoerden.grenzschutz.text: Land borders in the east and south, coasts on the Aegean and Mediterranean. Tight borders reduce smuggling and terror risk; Brussels is glad to pay for it.
behoerden.grenzschutz.leitung: Commander of Border and Coast Guard
behoerden.grenzschutz.leitung_f: Commander of Border and Coast Guard
behoerden.grenzschutz.personal.wirkung: More border officers: fewer irregular entries, lower terror threat.
behoerden.grenzschutz.technik.wirkung: Sensors, walls, boats: less smuggling and fewer entries.
behoerden.grenzschutz.reichweite.wirkung: Cooperation at crossings: lower terror threat, slightly more tourism.
behoerden.grenzschutz.instrument.name: Reinforced eastern border
behoerden.grenzschutz.instrument.text: A year of concentrated forces on the eastern border: fewer entries and lower terror threat, Brussels approves.
behoerden.cyber.name: Cyber Defence
behoerden.cyber.text: Protecting authorities, banks, power and water networks. An attack can cost days; defence is noticed only when it is missing.
behoerden.cyber.leitung: President of the Cyber Security Directorate
behoerden.cyber.leitung_f: President of the Cyber Security Directorate
behoerden.cyber.personal.wirkung: More specialists: networks and authorities run more stably.
behoerden.cyber.technik.wirkung: Better tools: investors trust the networks, the service finds foreign operations sooner.
behoerden.cyber.reichweite.wirkung: Cooperation with banks and operators: more market confidence.
behoerden.cyber.instrument.name: Shield for critical networks
behoerden.cyber.instrument.text: Six months of reinforced defence: foreign operations against Turkey are found sooner and do less harm.
behoerden.grund.hoechste: The highest level has been reached.
behoerden.grund.laeuft: An expansion is already under way; an agency can only absorb one at a time.
behoerden.grund.nicht: That is not possible right now.
behoerden.ausbau.why_etat: Costs {pk} capital and {bip, number, 3}% of GDP from the ministry budget; ready in {monate} months.
behoerden.ausbau.why_defizit: Costs {pk} capital and {bip, number, 3}% of GDP that the ministry budget does not cover and that goes onto the deficit; ready in {monate} months.
behoerden.ausbau.text: {name}: {achse} is being expanded to level {stufe}. Ready in {monate} months.
behoerden.kuerzung.why: Saves {bip, number, 3}% of GDP a year; experience and morale suffer at once.
behoerden.instrument.frei.text: The expansion makes a new instrument available: {instrument}.
behoerden.mit.gruppen.erfolg: The supported group puts pressure on the leadership: stability in {name} falls to {stabilitaet} out of 100.
behoerden.mit.gruppen.rueckschlag: Blowback: the supported group acts on its own, the terror threat rises in Turkey's border region.
behoerden.mit.cyberangriff.erfolg: Administration and services in {name} are disrupted for days; {n, plural, =0 {no running operation from there was affected} one {one operation from there against Turkey breaks off} other {# operations from there against Turkey break off}}.
behoerden.mit.netz.aufgeflogen_text: Authorities in {land} dismantle parts of the Turkish influence network; it falls back to level {stufe}, relations cool.
behoerden.mit.inland.grund.schutz: Reinforced protection runs for {monate} more months.
behoerden.mit.inland.aufklaerung.name: Domestic intelligence
behoerden.mit.inland.aufklaerung.text: An assessment of coup risk and terror cells. Lowers the terror threat slightly and shows the state of loyalty.
behoerden.mit.inland.terror.name: Counter-terrorism
behoerden.mit.inland.terror.text: Concentrated investigations against networks: if it works, the terror threat falls markedly.
behoerden.mit.inland.ueberwachung.name: Surveillance of the opposition
behoerden.mit.inland.ueberwachung.text: Material on political opponents brings capital. The price: press freedom and civil society suffer at once, and if it leaks, scandal and courts cost far more.
behoerden.mit.inland.schutz.name: Protection of the president
behoerden.mit.inland.schutz.text: Reinforced close protection and shielding of the presidency: coup plans have a harder time. Officers read it as distrust.
behoerden.mit.inland.why: Costs {pk} capital and {kap} service capacity; duration {monate} months.
behoerden.mit.inland.schutz.bericht: Protection of the president is reinforced for {monate} months; the officer corps takes it with unease.
behoerden.mit.inland.aufklaerung.erfolg: Domestic assessment: coup risk {putsch} out of 100, terror threat {terror} out of 100. Two cells broken up.
behoerden.mit.inland.terror.erfolg: A network is broken up: the terror threat falls markedly.
behoerden.mit.inland.ueberwachung.erfolg: Material on the opposition is available.
behoerden.mit.inland.ueberwachung.gerich: The surveillance becomes public; a court rules it unlawful, the material is worthless, and the government loses trust and legitimacy.
behoerden.mit.inland.ueberwachung.leck: The surveillance becomes public: scandal, trust and legitimacy fall, Strasbourg takes note.
behoerden.mit.inland.ueberwachung.leck_t: Wiretap scandal: the service watched the opposition
behoerden.ui.untertitel: Expansion costs capital, money and time; each further level brings less. Cuts save at once and cost experience.
behoerden.ui.unterhalt: Running cost versus today: {bip, number, 3}% of GDP a year
behoerden.ui.unterhalt_spar: Saving versus today: {bip, number, 3}% of GDP a year
behoerden.ui.etat_defizit: No ministry budget yet: the expansion goes on the deficit and costs one more capital.
behoerden.ui.kuerz_preis: Saves {bip, number, 3}% of GDP a year; experience is lost
behoerden.mit.ui.netze_leer: No networks yet. The service builds them in the world view (influence network); they can be exposed.
behoerden.mit.ui.inlandlage: Last domestic assessment ({monate, plural, one {one month ago} other {# months ago}}): coup risk {putsch} of 100, terror threat {terror} of 100.
behoerden.mit.ui.ausland: Operations against other states are ordered in the world view under “Service”.
behoerden.ui.etat_spielraum: Paid from the “{ressort}” budget: this year it still covers {bip, number, 3} % of GDP without new debt.
behoerden.ui.etat_kein: No room in the “{ressort}” budget: expansion and upkeep go onto the deficit. More money for the ministry in the budget creates room.
behoerden.ui.etat_gekuerzt: The “{ressort}” budget is cut below the budget law: every expansion goes onto the deficit and costs one more point of capital.
